titles.title: I Want to Be Happy in This Life

description:
After marrying the prince, Lillian suffers from his verbal and physical abuse. When the prince brings a mistress into the palace, Lillian becomes an even more neglected princess. After miscarrying her child due to the mistress's schemes, Lillian, overwhelmed by rage and sorrow, takes her own life. But when she opens her eyes, she's back on the day of the prince's proposal! She rejects his proposal, the source of all her misfortune, with the excuse, "I want to marry someone I love!" Enraged by the rejection, the prince sets an unreasonable condition that he'll force the marriage unless she brings her "beloved" fiancé to him. Now Lillian must find a suitable husband. Can Lillian find a husband who meets the conditions?

[Official English (No longer for Sale)](https://comics.inkr.com/title/4685-i-want-to-be-happy-in-this-life)
